text:
Ava N: Morning — ferry service just posted delays, possible cancellations this AM due to low visibility. https://status.ferry.example.com :cloud_rain:
Leo B: Ugh, I was planning to ferry in. Any suggestions?
Clara J: If you can, take the bridge — but slow lanes reported. Otherwise BART + light rail combo worked for me yesterday.
TransitBot: Notice: Ferry route F2 operating on reduced service until further notice. Estimated delay 30-50 mins.
Ava N: Thanks @TransitBot. Leaning toward BART. Does anyone have a spare Clipper pass? Mine is on my keyring at home.
Leo B: I have one but leaving from SoMa. Happy to pass it at the 9th & Market kiosk.
Clara J: Heads-up: 5th & Mission bike lane blocked with fallen tree, so if you're biking plan a detour.
CoffeeBot: Office coffee level: low. Espresso beans at 12% capacity. ETA for restock: 11:45.
Ava N: Anyone need a lift from the Embarcadero garage? I have room for two.
Leo B: @Ava N yes please, I’ll meet you at 8:10. Will Venmo for gas.
Clara J: I’ll stay remote today — street flooding near my building is a mess.
Ava N: Sent GIF "man holding umbrella in gale" :joy:
Leo B: Quick poll: are we doing in-person standup today? reply with "in" or "remote"
Clara J: remote
Ava N: in (maybe late)
TransitBot: Reminder: Expect gusts up to 40mph near the waterfront through 10:30.
Leo B: Thanks all. I'll update if I switch to driving. Safe rides :)
